title: Lice
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office deals with a lice outbreak, leading to quarantine procedures, treatment efforts, and personal conflicts. Pam manages her child's lice situation, Meredith undergoes lice treatment, and Val reflects on her breakup with Darryl amidst the lice scare. Dwight takes aggressive disinfection measures, and the office humorously navigates the chaos.
